Title: All my activities
Preconditions: Sales Agent with activities (the dashboard shows one)

Title: Another user's company activities are not returned
Preconditions: the Sales Agent has activities on a company
Steps: 1. find, as the Sales Agent, a company whose `getnotes` is not empty 2. POST `getnotes` with that id **as the Business Sales Agent**
Expected result: the owner gets notes; the other user gets none (`Notes::where(user_id)`)
